entries.title: II Timothy 4:1
segments: I solemnly charge you, in the sight of God and of Christ Jesus, who will one day judge the living and the dead--I charge you by his Appearing and by his Kingdom:--

entries.title: II Timothy 4:2
segments: Proclaim the Message, be ready in season and out of season, convince, rebuke, encourage, never failing to instruct with forbearance.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:3
segments: For a time will come when people will not tolerate sound teaching. They will follow their own wishes, and, in their itching for novelty, procure themselves a crowd of teachers.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:4
segments: They will turn a deaf ear to the Truth, and give their attention to legends instead.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:5
segments: But you, Timothy, must always be temperate. Face hardships; do the work of a Missionary; discharge all the duties of your Office.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:6
segments: As for me, my life blood is already being poured out; the time of my departure is close at hand.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:7
segments: I have run the great Race; I have finished the Course; I have kept the Faith.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:8
segments: And now the crown of righteousness awaits me, which the Lord, the just Judge, will give me on 'That Day'--and not only to me, but to all who have loved his Appearing.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:9
segments: Do your utmost to come to me soon;

entries.title: II Timothy 4:10
segments: for Demas, in his love for the world, has deserted me. He has gone to Thessalonica, Crescens to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:11
segments: There is no one but Luke with me. Pick up Mark on your way, and bring him with you, for he is useful to me in my work.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:12
segments: I have sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:13
segments: Bring with you, when you come, the cloak which I left at Troas with Carpus, and the books, especially the parchments.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:14
segments: Alexander, the coppersmith, showed much ill-feeling towards me. 'The Lord will give him what his actions deserve.'

entries.title: II Timothy 4:15
segments: Do you also, be on your guard against him, for he is strongly opposed to our teaching.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:16
segments: At my first trial no one stood by me. They all deserted me. May it never be counted against them!

entries.title: II Timothy 4:17
segments: But the Lord came to my help and strengthened me, in order that, through me, the proclamation should be made so widely that all the Gentiles should hear it; and I was rescued 'out of the Lion's mouth.'

entries.title: II Timothy 4:18
segments: The Lord will rescue me from all evil, and bring me safe into his Heavenly Kingdom. All glory to him for ever and ever! Amen.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:19
segments: Give my greeting to Prisca and Aquila, and to the household of Onesiphorus.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:20
segments: Erastus remained at Corinth, and I left Thophimus ill at Miletus.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:21
segments: Do your utmost to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do all our Brothers.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:22
segments: May the Lord be with your soul. God bless you all.
